review.alternative: Metric optimization alone could suffice in domains with fully closed and perfectly representative simulation environments.
review.would_change_mind: Empirical demonstration that uncurated metric optimization consistently discovers fundamental scientific breakthroughs without overfitting.

claims.statement: Autonomous systems must go beyond simple metric optimization to avoid artifacts such as the doppelgänger effect.

support.explanation: Demonstrates that naive performance metrics fail due to data leakage and metric overfitting.
support.passage: However, closer scrutiny reveals that many reported results do not hold under rigorous evaluation. This paper identifies prevalent, recurring issues in the field, including narrow datasets, hidden confounders that make supposedly independent test data effectively indistinguishable from the training data (the doppelgänger effect)

review.alternative: Rule-based scheduling might match performance if system dynamics are completely stationary and predictable.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence showing rule-based controllers systematically outperforming adaptive reinforcement learning agents in highly volatile operational environments.

claims.statement: Integration of automated hyperparameter selection and deep reinforcement learning enables real-time scheduling and constraint management in complex systems.

support.explanation: Illustrates how DRL agents manage complex operational constraints dynamically.
support.passage: Hence, a novel deep reinforcement learning agent (DRL), integrated with an automated hyperparameter selection feature, is proposed in this study for the real-time scheduling of a multi-energy system coupled with CDRT.
